method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 带 Julian 沿海湾南缘散步，一边是岩石树木一边是大海。
facts.anchor: They walk along the southern edge of the cove until there is nothing but rocks and trees on one side and the ocean on the other.

facts.fact: Julian 一路走在前头、低头在石头间跳跃，从离屋后没说过一句话、也没看 Hattie 一眼。
facts.anchor: He hasn’t said a word since they left the house. Hasn’t looked her in the eye.

facts.fact: 海面上一百码处有一只灰海豹浮出又迅速潜下。
facts.anchor: A gray seal surfaces a hundred yards out, then submerges just as quickly.

facts.fact: Julian 先开口，说父母是想让他离开好私下谈发生的事，Hattie 承认确实如此、他们要打电话。
facts.anchor: They wanted me to leave so they could talk about what happened.

facts.fact: Julian 问自己会不会坐牢，Hattie 太快回答说不、他们不会把小男孩送进监狱。
Julian 说出关键一句：他们不是我真正的爸妈，Hattie 一时语塞。
facts.anchor: They’re not my mom and dad. Not really.

facts.fact: Kevin 和 Wendy 在将近两年前向 Julian 说明了他的收养身世，他当时平静接受、此后未再提起，直到现在。
facts.anchor: Kevin and Wendy had explained Julian’s adoption to him almost two years ago.

facts.fact: Julian 盯着水面一动不动，说出“我不后悔”，随后起身沿海湾岸边往回走。
